verdict.rationale: The only payout-related evidence says merchants can 'change how you get paid' per merchant account. It does not specify payout timing, show when each payout lands, or offer next-day or instant acceleration, so it is at most an adjacent control. The vague 'financial reconciliation' marketing line does not document payout arrival visibility or faster payouts either.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see when each payout lands and speed it up (next-day or instant) when I need the cash
